progression.narrative: The performance opens on D3 and dwells most on D in Reng-e Delgosha. The line peaks at A4 (441.1 Hz) at 2:26.2. It closes on A4, not the tonic (D3 → Fs4 → E4 → Fs4 → E4 → A4).

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes

flags: tonic Fs set in the catalog (Segah's finalis, about 178.8 Hz (8 of the suite's 20 gushe-ha end there, including the daramad). The vote picked the 3rd above (A), Zabol's shahed (Farhat 1990, p. 52). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 441.8 Hz (Ak)
